name: ai-cs
description: Read-only marketplace CS collection, masked Google Sheets synchronization, and human-reviewed AI drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Collect masked CS and review AI reply drafts.
interface.longDescription: Uses the signed-in Chrome profile through the official Chrome capability for read-only collection, then calls a private authenticated MCP server to query or synchronize masked CS data. It never types or sends marketplace replies.
